top_stories.title: Titagarh, Jupiter Wagons shares rally up to 10% amid reports of Rs 40,000 crore order from Indian Railways - The Economic Times
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Indian Railways** is expected to issue a tender for the procurement of around 35,000-40,000 wagons annually, potentially boosting the shares of **Jupiter Wagons**, **Titagarh Rail Systems**, and **Texmaco Rail**.  The brokerage firm Jefferies initiated coverage on **Titagarh Rail Systems** with a ‘Buy’ rating and a target price of Rs 810, citing its potential to benefit from rising passenger and metro coach demand. They also highlighted the strong revenue visibility for **Titagarh Rail Systems** due to its large order book.  Jefferies assigned an 'Underperform' rating and a Rs 200 target price to **Jupiter Wagons**, while maintaining a ‘Buy’ rating on **Titagarh Rail Systems**.

top_stories.title: King Charles: Quote of the day by King Charles: “Relationships with fathers can be such complex ones. So often, I suppose, one must long to have got on better or to have been able to talk freely about the things that matter deeply but one was too inhibited to discuss.” | World News - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **King Charles III**'s quote about the complexities of father-child relationships resonates with many who have experienced similar feelings. The quote acknowledges the common desire to express deeper emotions and discuss meaningful topics, but often struggles to find the right moment.  While acknowledging that regret can stem from unspoken words, the quote also offers a hopeful message by encouraging individuals to take action and initiate conversations they may have postponed for years.

top_stories.title: Iran war day 87: Trump says US not in rush to sign deal, dashing optimism | Conflict News | Al Jazeera
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Donald Trump** has stated that the US is not in a rush to sign a deal with **Iran**, despite previous optimism about an imminent agreement.  The US blockade on Iranian ships in the Strait of Hormuz will remain in effect until an agreement is reached, certified, and signed. While **Iran** demands the release of frozen funds and the lifting of sanctions, the two sides remain at odds on several key issues such as Iran's nuclear ambitions and Israel's war in Lebanon.  The US Secretary of State, **Marco Rubio**, expressed hope for a "good agreement" while facing pushback from Republican hawks who oppose ending the US-Israel war on **Iran**.

top_stories.title: Haj begins as Middle East war's trajectory hangs in the balance - World - DAWN.COM
top_stories.rephrased_article: Over 1.5 million Muslims began the annual Haj pilgrimage in Makkah, with hopes for peace amidst geopolitical tensions. **Donald Trump**'s ongoing efforts to broker a ceasefire between Iran and other countries were overshadowed by the event.  Saudi officials emphasized security measures while pilgrims expressed their desire for peace. Despite the uncertainty surrounding the war in the Middle East, many pilgrims were ecstatic about fulfilling their religious duty.

top_stories.title: RAF jet carrying John Healey has signal jammed near Russia border
top_stories.rephrased_article: An **RAF** jet carrying UK Defence Secretary John Healey experienced a signal jam near the Russian border during a flight back to the UK. The incident, which occurred on Thursday, forced pilots to use alternative navigation systems as their GPS was disabled for three hours.  The Ministry of Defence is yet to comment on the incident.

top_stories.title: Melody effect: Wrong 'Parle' stock hits 5% upper circuit for 4th day, up 21% since PM Modi's gift for Meloni - The Economic Times
top_stories.rephrased_article: **PM Modi** gifted a bag of "Melody" candies to his Italian counterpart during a recent visit, sparking viral attention. **Parle Industries**, the company behind the candy, shared the video on social media and highlighted its global reach.  The moment has led to a surge in **Parle Products'** stock price, which is now trading at an all-time high. The company, however, does not currently plan to go public.

top_stories.title: Nepal Plastic Roads: “Rubbish roads” in Nepal: Turning plastic waste into roads to create cleaner cities | World News - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Nepal** is facing a growing plastic waste crisis, with insufficient recycling infrastructure in urban areas contributing to pollution. **Green Road Waste Management**, a local NGO founded by Bimal Bastola, has implemented a project using shredded plastics from snack packets and other packaging materials as asphalt in roads. This innovative approach aims to address both the issue of road quality and plastic waste management. While proponents believe it can create environmentally friendly solutions, environmental experts emphasize the need for further research on emissions, microplastic release, and road degradation. The government of **Nepal** is planning to test this technology in Kathmandu and hopes it will provide a model for other developing countries facing similar challenges.

top_stories.title: ‘Needless fuss’: Kerala CM V.D. Satheesan defends posting former State poll chief Rathan Kelkar as his Secretary - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Kerala Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan** stated that the appointment of **Rathan U. Kelkar**, former Chief Electoral Officer (Kerala), as his Secretary was not a cause for concern and dismissed criticisms from the opposition.  He emphasized that no political party in Kerala had accused Mr. Kelkar of election manipulation, noting that he was appointed by the previous CPI(M)-led LDF government. **Mr. Satheesan** further highlighted that Mr. Kelkar's appointment is not comparable to similar controversies in West Bengal where allegations against the CEO were made.

top_stories.title: Why the SpaceX IPO is the talk of Wall Street and beyond | Space News | Al Jazeera
top_stories.rephrased_article: **SpaceX**, Elon Musk's rocket company, is preparing for a highly anticipated initial public offering (IPO) on the Nasdaq. The IPO is expected to be the largest in history and could make Musk the world's first trillionaire.  The company aims to raise upwards of $80 billion, with 23 financial institutions underwriting the deal. **SpaceX** will grant its founder, Elon Musk, significant control over the company post-IPO, holding 85% of voting rights. The IPO is being closely watched as a defining moment for the nascent private space industry and could potentially raise more than three times the record-breaking $25.6 billion raised by Saudi Aramco in 2019.

top_stories.title: PSX opens shortened trading week on bullish note; KSE-100 gains 2,300 points during intraday trade - Business - DAWN.COM
top_stories.rephrased_article: The **Pakistan Stock Exchange’s** (PSX) benchmark index experienced a strong opening on Monday, gaining over 2,300 points during intraday trading. The KSE-100 index rose by 1.40 percent to reach 171,438 points, fueled by hopes of a soon-to-be-announced deal between the **United States** and **Iran** regarding the Strait of Hormuz. Oil prices also declined, further contributing to positive market sentiment.
